question: A house is supplied electricity through a 15 A fuse. The number of 100 W lamps that can be used simultaneously along with a 2KW AC is: (The AC and lamps both are rated for 220 V Supply)
solution:
The correct answer is **__1__3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Electric Power**

 
 
• The rate at which** energy** is converted into an** electrical circuit or work** is completed is known as electric power. To put it another way, it is a measure of how much energy is used over a time period.
 
• The formula for electric power is given by **P=VI**

 where V is the potential difference in the circuit and P is the power.

 I is the current of electricity.
 
• Power can also be written as **P=I²R and P= V²/R**
 
• Ohm's law is used to get the above two expressions, where voltage, current, and resistance are related in the following way: **V=IR​​**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Calculation**

 
 
• Calculate the **current** For **Electric lamps**,

 **Given,**

 Power of AC, Pac= 2KW= 2000W

 Power of lamps, Pl= 100W

 We know,

 Power, P=VI

 The current drawn by the lamp or electric current, I= Pac/V= 2000/220= 9.09A

 The main power supply of a house is through a 15 A fuse.

 **Maximum Electric current**, which can pass through lamps= 15- 9.09= **5.91A**
 
• Calculate the **number of lamps **connected in parallel

 Let the number of lamps= n

 and Current withdrawal by a single lamp, Ilamp

 Electrical current, Ilamp = Pl/v= 100/220= 0.45A

 **Maximum number of lamps**, n= 5.91/0.45= **13**

 Hence maximum**,13 lamps** can be connected in parallel with **AC**
